### 2026-10-10 – I started working on the schematic for my starboy, and this is my second time using Kicad since a long time, so it took some research on how to use the symbols and wire everything. I started by findin

**3h**

I started working on the schematic for my starboy, and this is my second time using Kicad since a long time, so it took some research on how to use the symbols and wire everything. I started by finding and figuring out how to find the components, but once I watched an overview of how to do it, things started going smoothly until I met with another obstacle. I had no idea what net labels were or what to do with them, so I researched and learned about them. The pictures below are of my entire components and a close-up of the components.

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 001523](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/cafb81eecf76372aea0c55d5f39e6be687dc622bdaac05f9ee89dd6cfcf93d07.jpg)
